system.description:
Favoured weapon: Cat-O-Nine-Tails

Granted power: Advantage on Stealth underground. Once/day: webs fill a 20ft radius within 60ft; each creature there makes a Reflex save or is Restrained for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Your Smite against a Restrained creature deals +1d6 poison damage.
